column3: Overseas Muslim Educational Trust of Sri Lanka
(Incorporation) Act, No. 51 of 2009

3.
The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is
constituted are hereby declared to be—

(a)
to provide scholarships for needy Sri Lankan Muslim
students  who  have  passed  General  Certificate  of
Education  (Advanced  Level)  Examination  and
entered  University  in  the  faculties  of  Science,
Engineering  and  Medicine;

(b)
to  provide  for  scholarships  for  needy  Muslim
students sitting the General Certificate of Education
(Advanced level) Examination in science subjects;

(c)
to financially assist needy Muslim students who are
already  in  University  and  who  are  unable  to
complete their courses of study due to insufficient
funds.

4.
(1) The  affairs  of  the  Corporatioh  shall,  subject  to
the  rules  of  the  Corporation  made  under  section  6,  be
administered by a Board of Governors (hereinafter referred to
as the “Board”) Consisting of the Chariman, Vice Chairman
and other office bearers elected or appointed in accordance
with the rules of the Corporation made under section 6.
(2) The first Board shall consist of the members of the
Board of Governors of the Educational Trust holding office
on the day immediately preceding the date of commencement
